title: PM-DAKSH Yojana (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi
summary: Schemes — PM-DAKSH Yojana (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi

items: o Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
o Objective: Skill development for marginalized communities including SC, OBC, EBC, waste
o Target Beneficiaries: 2.7 lakh people over 5 years.
o Compensation: Rs 500 - Rs 2500 based on attendance.
o Focus Areas: Construction, hospitality, retail, electronics, beauty, agriculture, etc.
o Implementing Agencies: NSFDC, NBCFDC, NSKFDC.
o Goal: Enhance employability and promote self-reliance among marginalized communities
